description:
The best value mid-drive electric hunting bike on the market — and we dare you to find better.

If you're tired of overpriced mid-drive electric bikes that don't deliver, the Rambo Roamer 2.0 was built for you. Leading Rambo's mid-drive lineup, the Roamer 2.0 combines a public-land-friendly 750W Bafang motor with a Shimano 8-speed drivetrain, aggressive terrain tires, and a feature set that rivals bikes costing $1,000 more.

Mid-Drive Performance. Real-World Value.
Mid-drive motors sit at the bike's center of gravity and directly drive the chain — delivering better hill-climbing torque, more natural pedal feel, and greater efficiency than hub-drive systems. The Roamer 2.0 brings genuine mid-drive performance to a price point that won't make you wince.

Why Hunters & Trail Riders Choose the Roamer 2.0

⚙️ 750W Bafang mid-drive motor — public-land legal, powerful, and efficient
🔄 Shimano 8-speed drivetrain — up to 65 miles of range per charge
🛞 Kenda 24" aggressive-terrain tires — excellent clearance on rough terrain
🍂 Uding front fork — smooth ride on rocks, roots, and field edges
📦 Extra-large rear rack — haul your gear with ease
🌧️ PDW Mud Shovel front and rear fenders — standard equipment
📱 Bafang LCD with Adjustable Class System (ACS) — clean, simple display

Who Is the Roamer 2.0 For?
The Roamer 2.0 is the perfect choice for deer hunters, trail riders, and outdoor adventurers who want mid-drive performance, 65 miles of range, and real Rambo build quality — without the flagship price tag. Whether you're cutting through beanfields to your stand or exploring new trail systems, the Roamer 2.0 is built to handle it.

Go ahead — try to find a better value in the mid-drive market. We dare you.
